verdict.rationale: Ardent's own CLI has a Prisma-specific connection-string option (`--url-type prisma`), which shows deliberate ORM support for Prisma. It branches standard Postgres, but the pack contains no framework or ORM integration guides. missing for 10: documented guides for Prisma, Drizzle, Django and Rails; evidence of out-of-the-box compatibility beyond a Prisma URL flag; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the database works out of the box with my ORM and framework (Prisma, Drizzle, Django, Rails) with documented guides
